findings.title: Unauthenticated GET table
findings.description: The route declaration has no authentication decorator, middleware or session check in its surrounding lines, while the path points at per-user or global data.
findings.exploit: Call the endpoint directly without any session or token.
findings.breaker: Usually none: checkers keep using authenticated endpoints, so teams read the data freely while scoring continues.
findings.remediation: Apply the same auth guard used by the neighbouring routes.

findings.title: Deterministic secret derived only from public data
findings.description: Invites, slugs, dialog tokens or session keys computed from the login alone are guessable by anyone who knows the victim's username.
findings.exploit: Recompute the value for a known username and use it.
findings.breaker: A predictable format is a prerequisite for the checker, which scrapes such values out of responses. Changing the format silently breaks the checker; leaking the value to teams does not.
